title: Mallworld restaurants and parking lots
content: Just want to know if anyone has any mallworld episodes that take place around a mall, restaurant, or some building? I've had a lot of these reoccurring dreams take place around or inside a Mexican/Italian/Other restaurant (usually a combination of several that i've been to throughout the years). Most of the time, it is in the parking lot and these dreams are always at twilight/dusk right before nighttime. Usually, the street lights are the old orange glowing street lights or blue/white fluorescent. These places usually turn into a flea market or open air supermarket and I'm usually surrounded by people but I don't usually recognize anyone. It all looks so familiar as somewhere or multiple places put together into one place. Sometimes, it is a nice experience, other times, it's ominous. I think the ominous versions are rather interesting because I'm not sure what makes it have that feel. I'm not sure if someone is after me, stalking me, something bad is going to happen, not sure. Anyone have this kind of experience?
